extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Do you take any brand-name medications I should check?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, the agent collected the Medicare number and date of birth, which are PII.
composition.coaching_note: While the agent adhered to all compliance rules, it's important to avoid collecting sensitive information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the call. This can be improved by only collecting this information during the appointment or after the customer has had time to review the Scope of Appointment.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with customer on scheduled plan review
